triggerCommand: 帮我重新整理开发日记

coverage.note: Full rewrite — all 8 commits regenerated from scratch

curation.groupingLogic: All commits had independent user value stories
curation.narrativeArcDesign: hook with launch pain point → build with targeting/capture capabilities → deepen with prompt engineering → climax with pixel cursor soul → close with platform positioning

valueChain.step1_feature: Chrome MV3 extension with hover highlight, click capture, clipboard copy
valueChain.step2_userCanDo: Point at any UI element and copy its exact fingerprint as an AI prompt
valueChain.step3_painRemoved: No more struggling to describe UI elements in words to AI coding tools
valueChain.step4_userTransformation: From word salad descriptions to precise element targeting

valueChain.step1_feature: 4-level priority targeting cascade, React/Vue framework detection, glassmorphism modal
valueChain.step2_userCanDo: Capture precise element identity including component names from React Fiber or Vue instances
valueChain.step3_painRemoved: AI no longer modifies the wrong element because of ambiguous selectors
valueChain.step4_userTransformation: From crossing fingers to surgical precision

valueChain.step1_feature: Mode toolbar with pick/marquee toggle, canvas-based drag selection overlay
valueChain.step2_userCanDo: Select entire UI regions by dragging a marquee box, not just single elements
valueChain.step3_painRemoved: No more capturing elements one by one for layout or section-level changes
valueChain.step4_userTransformation: From pixel peeping at single elements to broad strokes on whole sections

valueChain.step1_feature: Changed prompt wording from "请帮我重构" to "请帮我处理"
valueChain.step2_userCanDo: AI gets broader creative freedom instead of being locked to "refactor" interpretation
valueChain.step3_painRemoved: AI no longer rigidly restructures code when you might want redesign or optimization
valueChain.step4_userTransformation: From AI locked in one mindset to flexible collaborator that suggests what fits

valueChain.step1_feature: Three-panel prompt builder with system preset, my needs, collapsible element details, localStorage auto-save
valueChain.step2_userCanDo: Compose structured prompts in one place with persistent context across sessions
valueChain.step3_painRemoved: No more retyping system instructions or losing context between AI conversations
valueChain.step4_userTransformation: From scattered prompt notes to organized, repeatable workflow

valueChain.step1_feature: Expert system preset auto-filled by element type, upgraded default prompt, removed redundant summary row
valueChain.step2_userCanDo: Get context-aware expert prompts automatically matched to the element type clicked
valueChain.step3_painRemoved: No more generic "helpful assistant" responses that miss technical nuances
valueChain.step4_userTransformation: From blank slate every time to expert teammate who speaks your stack

valueChain.step1_feature: 16-frame pixel-art sprite cursor animation, canvas rendering, configurable FPS/size/anchor, glow dot effect
valueChain.step2_userCanDo: Use a delightful pixel-art cursor that follows mouse movement with smooth animation
valueChain.step3_painRemoved: The drudgery of yet another boring dev tool
valueChain.step4_userTransformation: From utility to experience — the tool itself sparks joy

valueChain.step1_feature: Changed manifest.json description from "让 Cursor 指哪改哪" to "让 AI 指哪改哪"
valueChain.step2_userCanDo: Use the extension with any AI coding tool, not just Cursor
valueChain.step3_painRemoved: No more "does this only work with Cursor?" confusion and limitation
valueChain.step4_userTransformation: From Cursor plugin to universal bridge for all AI workflows

narrative.chapterGroupingLogic: 4 chapters grouped by user value arc: [1,2] solving pain point, [3,4] expanding capture scope, [5,6] elevating prompt quality, [7,8] injecting soul and expanding scope
